texts.content:
From: Harborview Inn
To: Emily Chen
Subject: Booking Confirmation #HV4402

Dear Ms. Chen,
Thank you for choosing Harborview Inn. We are pleased to confirm your stay:

Check-in: Friday, August 15 (from 3 P.M.)
Check-out: Sunday, August 17 (by 11 A.M.)
Room: Queen room with ocean view
Breakfast: included each morning, 7–10 A.M.

As you requested, we have arranged an airport pickup for 2:30 P.M. on your arrival day. Your driver will hold a sign with your name outside Gate C.

Free parking is not available, but guests receive a discount at the city garage across the street. You may cancel without charge until 48 hours before check-in.

We look forward to welcoming you.
The Harborview Inn Team

questions.stem: How many nights will Ms. Chen stay at the inn?
questions.explanation: She checks in on "Friday, August 15" and checks out on "Sunday, August 17," which is two nights.

questions.stem: What is suggested about Ms. Chen?
options: A. She will drive her own car to the inn.
B. She will travel to the city by plane.
C. She will arrive at the inn after 3 P.M.
D. She booked a room without breakfast.
questions.explanation: The inn "arranged an airport pickup" at her request, so she is most likely flying.

options: A. Guests can park at the inn for free.
B. Parking must be reserved 48 hours ahead.
C. Guests can save money at a nearby garage.
D. Parking is located near Gate C.
questions.explanation: "Free parking is not available, but guests receive a discount at the city garage across the street."
